commands.stdout:
Usage: frame-compare run [OPTIONS]                                            
                                                                               
 Compare video sources and generate screenshots and an optional report.        
                                                                               
 Overrides apply to this run only. Add --write-config to save the effective    
 configuration, including the source, frame-selection, rendering, alignment,   
 and publishing overrides below, to the selected config file and exit without  
 running. Other options, such as --root or --quiet, are run-only and never     
 persist.                                                                      
                                                                               
┌─ Options ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --help          Show this message and exit.                                 │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
┌─ Workspace and configuration ───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --root    -r      <path>  Workspace root containing configuration, input,   │
│                           and generated output.                             │
│                           [default: .]                                      │
│ --config  -c      <path>  Config file; relative paths resolve from --root.  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
┌─ Sources and frame selection ───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --input               -i      <path>          Use this source-video         │
│                                               directory.                    │
│ --frames                      FRAME[,FRAME…]  Select reference source-frame │
│                                               numbers to render.            │
│ --random-frame-count          COUNT           Set the random frame count.   │
│ --dark-frame-count            COUNT           Set the dark-frame count;     │
│                                               requires analysis.            │
│ --bright-frame-count          COUNT           Set the bright-frame count;   │
│                                               requires analysis.            │
│ --motion-frame-count          COUNT           Set the motion-frame count;   │
│                                               requires analysis.            │
│ --seed                        <int>           Set the frame-selection seed. │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
┌─ Rendering and alignment ───────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --tm-preset                          PRESET  Override the tonemap preset.   │
│                                              Choose one of: reference,      │
│                                              filmic, contrast, bt2390_spec, │
│                                              spline, bright_lift,           │
│                                              highlight_guard,               │
│                                              highlight_preserve.            │
│ --tm-target                          NITS    Override tonemap target nits.  │
│ --tm-curve                           CURVE   Override the tonemap curve.    │
│                                              Choose one of: bt2390, spline, │
│                                              reinhard.                      │
│ --tm-speed                           SPEED   Override the tonemap speed.    │
│                                              Choose one of: quality, fast.  │
│ --overlay                            MODE    Override screenshot overlay    │
│                                              mode. Choose one of: minimal,  │
│                                              standard, diagnostic, none.    │
│ --force-interactive-alignment                Force VSView alignment.        │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
┌─ Reports and publishing ────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --no-upload          Do not publish to slow.pics.                           │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
┌─ Planning and diagnostics ──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --skip-analysis            Skip metric analysis; dark, bright, and motion   │
│                            counts must be zero.                             │
│ --skip-metadata            Skip TMDB metadata lookup for this run.          │
│ --no-cache                 Refresh the current scoped analysis cache entry; │
│                            preserve other cached entries.                   │
│ --from-cache-only          Require valid cached analysis; never recompute   │
│                            missing metrics.                                 │
│ --dry-run                  Preview what a run would use and create without  │
│                            probing or side effects.                         │
│ --write-config             Write the effective config, then exit without    │
│                            running.                                         │
│ --diagnose-paths           Print resolved workspace paths as JSON, then     │
│                            exit.                                            │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
┌─ Output modes ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --json                Emit machine-readable JSON instead of human           │
│                       summaries.                                            │
│ --no-color            Disable colored output.                               │
│ --quiet     -q        Suppress progress and detailed human summaries.       │
│ --verbose   -v        Enable debug logging and verbose error details.       │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                                                                               
 Examples:                                                                     
                                                                               
 Preview the configured comparison:                                            
 frame-compare run --dry-run                                                   
                                                                               
 Add exact frames and a diagnostic overlay to one local run (configured frame  
 selection still applies):                                                     
 frame-compare run --frames 120,1200,2400 --overlay diagnostic --no-upload     
                                                                               
 Save an override without running:                                             
 frame-compare run --overlay diagnostic --write-config
